explanation: Across all retrieved transitions (VID92_00689, VID96_00956, VID62_01091, VID79_01617, VID01_00698), clipping the cystic duct prior to achieving a full Critical View of Safety shifts the operation to the clipping-and-cutting phase without immediate bleeding, but places the common bile duct at high risk. Subsequent actions are equally split between retracting the gallbladder (VID62_01091, VID79_01617) and clipping the cystic artery (VID92_00689, VID96_00956), with grasping the gallbladder less frequent (VID01_00698).
